description: Find failed login attempts by user
query: SigninLogs | where ResultType != 0 | summarize FailedCount = count() by UserPrincipalName | where FailedCount > 3

description: Detect successful logins from different locations
query: SigninLogs | where ResultType == 0 | summarize by UserPrincipalName, Location

description: Find events from a specific source IP
query: SecurityEvent | where IpAddress == '192.168.1.10' | project TimeGenerated, Account, Activity

description: Detect multiple failed logins in a short window
query: SigninLogs | where ResultType != 0 | summarize Count = count() by UserPrincipalName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) | where Count > 5
SecurityEvent | where Activity contains 'process' | project TimeGenerated, Account, Activity
SecurityEvent | where Activity contains 'network' | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Activity
SecurityEvent | where Activity contains 'account' | project TimeGenerated, Account, Activity
AzureActivity | project TimeGenerated, Caller, OperationName, ActivityStatus
